config._adjudication: fastchess.sh's line verbatim, including twosided=true (S212, DEC-174), as tools/spsa_s222.json and tools/spsa_s231.json carry it.
config._book: books/UHO_4060_v3.epd and not the harness book, as S085, S222 and S231 did: a run must not tune on the openings its verification plays (adocs/eval_tuning_strategy.md par.7, DEC-209 clause 1), and fastchess.sh verifies on books/noob_3moves.epd since DEC-189. 30000 rounds against 242201 openings, so the book never wraps.
config._c_end: DEV_MANUAL 'Sizing a real run': about four times the smallest change that could plausibly matter, so that +/-c costs about 1 Elo. Margins in centipawns take S085's 24, a quarter of chesso's 94-point pawn; integer plies and depths take 1, depth caps over 0..16 take 2 (S085's AspirationMinDepth); the five 0..2 axes and the two 0..3 / 0..4 axes take 0.5, the driver's floor, because one ply already spans most of their range. Where 4x would put the first iteration's 2*c0 = 4.11*c_end past the declared range (Config.warnings()), c_end is cut until it fits. The five 0..2 axes still warn at iteration 0 only: 4.11 * 0.5 = 2.05 against a range of 2. LmrBase and LmrDivisor keep S085's own 24 and 32 (DEC-269).
config._not_here: No Tm* axis: DEC-094 keeps the time-management family out of a lane tuned at a control its verification does not share, S132's own file says the three TmNode* axes want the playing control or a second-control verification, and DEC-200 keeps TmHardPercent out of every config. No switch (QsFutility, QsQueenPromotions, RfpTtEstimate, SeExtend, SeMultiCut, ProbCut): DEC-215, a verdict switch and not a setting. None of S222's eleven: that lane fitted them on 2026-09-14/15 and S231's refit of the one-ply three left with its H0. Ten of S085's twelve stay out: S085 fitted them and the accepts names only axes added or reseeded after it; DEC-269 brings in LmrBase and LmrDivisor and leaves MaxQsearchDepth and AspirationDelta to S127, as S112 and S115 do. RazorDepth: above 1 is a different rule that S116 parks for S127 with a depth-scaled margin. LmrRoundBias: S236 measured every value above its off value 0 losing a fast-suite mate row, so no endpoint but 0 could pass accepts (4).
config._seed: 261, this step's own id. A seed chosen for its trajectory would be a result chosen after the number.
config._what: S261, the search block's own SPSA lane (DEC-222 (8)). Thirty-one axes: every parameter in src/search_params.hpp added or reseeded after S085's run that no later lane fitted, less the six verdict switches, the three TmNode* axes, RazorDepth and LmrRoundBias, each excluded by name with its reason in the step file's pre-registration, item (1) -- thirty -- plus LmrBase and LmrDivisor, the reduction table the five LMR terms sit on, which DEC-269 adds as an amendment to accepts (1). SePlyFactor left on 2026-10-13 by item (1)'s refusal rule: `check` found 2 and 8 searching the same node count on all four rungs, and the symbol is read (src/search.cpp, the singular-extension guard), so it is the parameter and not the wiring. Thirty-one axes at S085's regime, one night. adocs/data/S261_spsa.sh is the runner; the step file adocs/plan_current/S261_search_block_spsa_lane.md is the pre-registration; this file is the frozen input. What the SPRT after it judges is the whole vector and not any one axis (DEC-210's reading, one vector under one verdict).
